# Attribution

Texts from [Sefaria](https://www.sefaria.org) used by ein-mishpat-ai: 8,298 text versions. Generated 2026-11-17 from the project's version metadata. Each version is listed with its title, language, version title, source and license as Sefaria publishes them. `used in`: training (the models), KesherBench (the benchmark files).

## Licenses

Sefaria names each license without a version number; the links are the ones Sefaria's own site uses.

|---|---|---|
| [CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) | CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication) | 1,183 |
| [CC-BY](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) | Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (CC BY 3.0) | 735 |
| [CC-BY-SA](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/) | Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 (CC BY-SA 3.0) | 123 |

| unknown (Sefaria) | unknown: Sefaria gives no license; not redistributed here (see below). | 1,068 |

## Changes made to the texts

Footnotes, HTML markup and extra whitespace were removed and the texts were split into segments (Sefaria's references); in KesherBench the Hebrew/Aramaic is given without vowel points, cantillation and a few marks (maqaf, paseq, parasha markers). Wording was not changed. CC-BY-SA texts redistributed in KesherBench are shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 (allowed by CC BY-SA 3.0 for adaptations), each row keeping its own license. No endorsement by Sefaria or by the rights holders is implied.

## Notes

No non-commercial (CC-BY-NC) or no-derivatives (CC-BY-ND) versions were used. CC-BY-SA texts that are redistributed (KesherBench) stay under CC-BY-SA. Versions marked "unknown" are not redistributed: KesherBench gives references to them (its fetch script takes the texts from Sefaria). LLM-written translations and queries were used for training only and are not published.
